parsed.scene_description: A blurred warehouse interior with stacks of red plastic crates on wooden pallets. A forklift is visible in the background. The ceiling has fluorescent lights and structural beams. White-wrapped goods are stacked to the right. Motion blur suggests camera movement.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked high on wooden pallets, occupying left and center foreground. Crates have white labels. Blurred due to motion. Some are stacked asymmetrically. Directly on pallets, supported by them.

objects.label: wooden pallet
objects.observation: Beneath red crates in foreground. Made of wood planks. Partially obscured by crates. Supports the weight of the crates above it. Located near center of frame.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Red and black vehicle in mid-ground, slightly out of focus. Appears to be moving. Behind crate stacks. No clear interaction with other objects. Possibly transporting goods.

objects.label: white wrapped goods
objects.observation: Stacked high on pallets to the far right. Wrapped in white material. Blurred due to motion. Not interacting with other objects directly. Located near warehouse wall.

objects.label: warehouse ceiling
objects.observation: Visible at top of frame. Contains fluorescent lights and exposed beams. Illuminates the space. No direct contact with objects below. Appears static despite motion blur.
